name: ConnectionFactoryAndUnitOfWork

connection_factory.open: open new sqlcipher3 DB-API compatible connection with timeout=5s and same-thread use; before any schema/data read obtain LLD-12 live-DEK handle, key connection with SqlCipherConnectionSecurityProvider, then verify cipher provider/version/profile and sqlite_master readability
required_connection_setup: LLD-12 verify_cipher_connection(connection) succeeds for SQLCipher 4.17.0 profile
verify persisted journal_mode is wal for authoritative runtime connections
startup_database_setup: set PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL only while canonical instance ownership is held and after cipher verification
verify journal mode result before readiness
connection_factory.optional_defense_in_depth: when packaged SQLCipher/SQLite exposes SQLITE_DBCONFIG_DEFENSIVE/TRUSTED_SCHEMA, enable defensive mode and disable trusted schema; packaged-runtime tests pin availability/behavior
connection_factory.secret_rule: raw DEK/key handle is scoped to connection setup, never returned to repository/domain code, audit, diagnostics or error payloads
connection_factory.failure: any key/cipher/setup verification failure closes connection and returns SECURITY_NOT_READY or PERSISTENCE_CONNECTION_UNSAFE without attempting unkeyed fallback

write_unit_of_work.nested_policy: a second independent UnitOfWork on the same logical command is forbidden; collaborators receive the existing UnitOfWork/repository set
write_unit_of_work.commit: execute literal COMMIT after all domain/evidence/receipt/audit writes succeed
write_unit_of_work.rollback: on any BaseException while in_transaction execute ROLLBACK; if rollback fails, close connection and surface PERSISTENCE_ROLLBACK_FAILURE without reporting success
write_unit_of_work.busy_policy: BEGIN IMMEDIATE may wait up to busy_timeout; SQLITE_BUSY/SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT maps to retryable PERSISTENCE_BUSY and performs no accepted writes

read_query.default: one keyed/verified read connection, bound-parameter SELECTs, no write statements
read_query.consistent_snapshot: for multi-query report/projection consistency execute BEGIN, perform reads, then COMMIT; snapshot duration is bounded and never includes operator think-time
read_query.query_only: read-dedicated connections set PRAGMA query_only=ON after key/cipher and ordinary safety verification
read_query.overview: LLD-11 OverviewReadSnapshotFactory returns one shared snapshot context for every owner projection contributing to one response

repository_rules: repositories receive a DatabaseConnectionV1/UnitOfWork and never open unmanaged connections
SQL values use driver-bound parameters only; interpolation/concatenation for values is forbidden
one execute call contains one SQL statement
driver row objects are converted at repository boundary and never escape into domain values
connection objects never cross thread boundaries
performance_rules: write transactions contain only current-state load, revalidation, bounded mutation, required evidence/audit and commit
file/mail/workbook parsing and expensive calculations execute before transaction
batch commands preflight outside transaction then commit accepted atomic partitions with fresh revalidation
do not add caches/denormalized authority until a measured query requires a rebuildable projection
